faqs.q: Sec. 102-63. - Setting and inspection of installations.
faqs.a:
The city will set all water meters that are two inches in size or less. All work performed
               by contractors for meter pit installations will be inspected by the city at the time
               of setting the water meter. The cost of customary meter settings and the associated
               inspections is included in applicable fees. Where additional inspections are made
               necessary by incomplete or faulty work or missing parts, a fee of $20.00 will be charged
               for each additional inspection. This fee shall be paid to the department of utilities
               by the holder of the water permit before another request for the water meter installation
               inspection will be accepted.
(Code 1981, § 33-38; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988)
